flags.name: AGENTIC_SPACE_RETRIEVAL_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS18-S5: a Do run in a project forwards its Space retrieval decision to execution-core so knowledge_search is Space-scoped. Off, org-wide. Deploy execution-core (reads x-space-retrieval-authorization) first. Only the literal true.

flags.name: AGENTIC_SUBSCRIPTION_ALLOW_EFFECTS
flags.purpose: Second Do-mode switch. Lets subscription runs take effects. It grants nothing while AGENTIC_SUBSCRIPTION_ENABLED is off.

flags.name: AGENTIC_SUBSCRIPTION_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Do-mode master switch for ChatGPT-subscription runs, the agentic loop.

flags.name: AGENT_DEFINITION_VERSIONS
flags.purpose: EP-6 S7/S8: the agent builder routes (draft, publish, versions) and the draft preview of a chat body. Off, the builder routes answer 404 and a chat body's agent_preview is left as it came. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: ALLOWED_MODELS
flags.purpose: Comma-separated model allowlist for the gateway. Unset or empty allows every model.

flags.name: ALLOW_DEV_ACTOR_HEADERS
flags.purpose: Dev actor headers for the BFF. Refused, with a log line, when APP_ENV is production or prod.

flags.name: ALLOW_DEV_AUTH_BYPASS
flags.purpose: Dev auth bypass for the BFF. Refused, with a log line, when APP_ENV is production or prod.

flags.name: ALLOW_INSECURE_DEV_DEFAULTS
flags.purpose: Lets a release build boot with placeholder dev keys. Development only, and APP_ENV does not refuse it. Several planes read this name; Model Plane compose forwards it blank.

flags.name: API_KEY_AGENT_EXCHANGE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: API-key exchange route for browser:agent grants (auth-core api-key-exchange.controller.ts). Needs API_KEY_ENABLED too. Only the literal true turns it on; off, the route answers 404.

flags.name: API_KEY_AGENT_RUNS
flags.purpose: INNH-10 GW-1: the x-api-key ingress for browser agent runs (/api/v1/api-key/agent/runs). Off, the routes are not mounted. Only 1 or the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: APPROVAL_AUDIT_EVENTS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS13-S3: the approval decision audit event, a content-free approval_decided outbox row and its provenance record. Off by default; only the literal true.

flags.name: APPROVAL_RULE_PROPOSALS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS13-S7 'Always' rule proposals and their list, confirm and dismiss routes. Needs APPROVAL_SCOPE_GRANTS_ENABLED, and TOOL_POLICY_ENFORCED plus TOOL_POLICY_RULE_AUDIT_ENABLED on capability-core. Only the literal true.

flags.name: APPROVAL_SCOPE_GRANTS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS13-S6 standing grants. Session-core refuses to boot with it on and APPROVAL_AUDIT_EVENTS_ENABLED off (K3-2). Keep off until execution-core holds approval:grant_use (D-WS13-5) and grants are digest-bound (W2-WS13-S7-grant-digest).

flags.name: APPROVAL_SHELL_RULE_PROPOSALS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-9 E4: shell-rule narrowing of WS13-S7 rule proposals. Stays off (D-WS13-6). Refused at startup unless APPROVAL_RULE_PROPOSALS_ENABLED is on.

flags.name: APPROVAL_WAIVER_REFUSE
flags.purpose: D2-1149: an approval create or decide from a waived run's credential is refused before any approval metadata is stored (DEC-32: waived counts as ZDR for new stores). Off keeps today's behaviour. Only the literal true.

flags.name: ASSISTANT_NAVIGATION_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Kill switch for the assistant navigation model call. Off, the route answers 503 assistant_navigation_unavailable and no model call is made. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: AUDIT_ALLOW_NATS_TOKEN_FALLBACK
flags.purpose: Security-relaxing migration switch: audit-core and its extra NATS buses may connect with the shared NATS token instead of a scoped NATS user and password. Off requires the scoped credential. Only the literal 1 turns it on.

flags.name: AUDIT_CHAIN_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Audit hash chain on audit-core ingest (cmd/server). Only the literal 1 turns it on. In production it needs the chain signing keys.

flags.name: AUDIT_CHAIN_PRUNE_DRYRUN
flags.purpose: Dry run of the chained audit purge in audit-core: it verifies and logs the plan, deletes no chained row, and wins over AUDIT_CHAIN_PRUNE_ENABLED. Unchained rows and usage events still age out. Only the literal 1 turns it on.

flags.name: AUDIT_CHAIN_PRUNE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Pruning of audit rows, each batch signed by a chain checkpoint (audit-core cmd/server). Only the literal 1 turns it on; AUDIT_CHAIN_PRUNE_DRYRUN=1 wins and never deletes. Needs the chain signing keys when on.

flags.name: AUDIT_CHAIN_VERIFY_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Chain verifier on audit-core (cmd/server, verifier.Enabled). Blank follows AUDIT_CHAIN_ENABLED. Only the literal 0 turns verification off, and it is always off with the chain off. Read-only.

flags.name: AUDIT_SIEM_ALLOW_PRIVATE_DESTINATIONS
flags.purpose: Dev-only lift of the SIEM address check for private destinations (audit-core cmd/siem-exporter). Only the literal 1 turns it on; with ENVIRONMENT=production the exporter refuses to start.

flags.name: AUDIT_SIEM_EXPORT_ENABLED
flags.purpose: SIEM export of the audit chain (audit-core cmd/siem-exporter). Only the literal 1 turns it on; off, the process serves metrics and exports nothing.

flags.name: AUTH_CORE_ZDR_EFFECTIVE_POSTURE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: ZDR-Z-03b: Auth Core reads the effective ZDR posture that org-core computes (effectiveZdr) instead of keeping its own plan-lapse rule. Off keeps the stored-intent rule. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: AZURE_ANTHROPIC_ZDR_CONFIRMED
flags.purpose: Legacy ZDR boolean for the Azure Anthropic surface. An unattested true fails boot, because ZDR now needs the attestation fields. Leave false.

flags.name: AZURE_OPENAI_ZDR_CONFIRMED
flags.purpose: Legacy ZDR boolean for the Azure OpenAI surface. An unattested true fails boot, because ZDR now needs the attestation fields. Leave false.

flags.name: BROWSER_BROKER_FILL_OTP_ENABLED
flags.purpose: fill_otp sensitive approvals (E3.1, ADR-2a) in the browser broker: a one-time OTP fill bound to one https origin and one mail connection. Off until the OTP live proof; remove the switch after it.

flags.name: BROWSER_DO_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS21-S2: mints a browser bearer for a personal, non-ZDR agentic turn. Either this or BROWSER_SITES_ENABLED turns on the browser-site settings routes. Off, neither happens. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: BROWSER_LIVE_VIEW_ONLY
flags.purpose: W3-E3.4-5: serves the owner view-only live route for a browser session. Off, that route answers 404. Quarry honours the scope only with QUARRY_EDGE__LIVE_VIEW_ONLY on. Only 1, true, yes or on turns it on.

flags.name: BROWSER_POLICY_ADMIN_API
flags.purpose: WS7.H: the organisation browser policy admin routes. Off, or unset, answers 404 browser_policy_admin_disabled. Only 1, true, yes or on (or TRUE, YES, ON) turns it on.

flags.name: BROWSER_REGION_ATTACH
flags.purpose: E3.3-d: the browser region and selection attach route. The gateway re-resolves the tab and region against Quarry before it attaches the crop as browser-scraped evidence. Off, the route is not mounted. Only 1, true, yes or on turns it on.

flags.name: BROWSER_SITES_ENABLED
flags.purpose: The browser-site settings routes for the assistant (/api/v1/orgs/{id}/browser-sites). Either this or BROWSER_DO_ENABLED turns them on. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: BROWSER_TAB_MENTIONS
flags.purpose: E3.3-c: re-resolves @tab mentions in a chat turn against Quarry live tab list before a model sees them. Off, the route is not mounted. Only 1, true, yes or on turns it on.

flags.name: CAPABILITY_PERMISSION_RULES_ENABLED
flags.purpose: F-t3-074 org permission rules: execution-core names a call's target and capability-core applies the org's deny and ask rules to it. Only the literal true turns it on; off, no target is sent and no rule is read.

flags.name: CHAT_ARTIFACT_PROMOTE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-3 S8: saves a document artifact version to knowledge from the Output panel. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CHAT_LOCALE_HINT
flags.purpose: WS16-S6: stamps the viewer interface language (nb-NO or en-US) on the model-bound body as the locale field. Off removes the field. A framing hint only, never stored. Any value other than 1, true, yes or on turns it off.
flags.onDefaultReason: Dev default on through space_flag: an unset value is on outside production. The production overlay sets it false.

flags.name: CHAT_MEDIA_TRANSCRIPTS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: W5, F-t3-090: POST /api/v1/chat/transcripts, which transcribes one audio upload and saves the text as a private media_transcript document. Off, the route answers 404 media_transcripts_disabled. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CHAT_PROCESS_OUTPUT_READ_ENABLED
flags.purpose: W4-P3: the owner's read of one background process's output, GET /api/v1/chat/runs/{run_id}/processes/{pid}/output. Off, the route answers 404 process_output_disabled. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CHAT_SNAPSHOTS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: W4-SH-6: the owner's governed snapshot links and the member's read of a shared snapshot. Off, every snapshot route answers 404 chat_snapshots_disabled. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CLIENT_ENV_IDENTITY
flags.purpose: F-t3-098: GET /api/v1/client-config reports the closed environment label (production, staging, development or other) derived from APP_ENV. Off, the key is left out. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CLIENT_MIN_CONTRACT
flags.purpose: The oldest client contract the gateway still serves (WS07-S3). A higher value moves stale tabs onto the banner. It never goes below the compiled-in floor, and an unparsable value is ignored.

flags.name: CLIENT_VERSION_POLICY
flags.purpose: WS07-S3: what a stale client does. off shows nothing, banner shows a non-blocking notice, and enforce may reload a tab that holds no unsaved work. Unknown values are banner.

flags.name: CODEX_SUBSCRIPTION_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Codex broker for the user's own ChatGPT subscription. Off, the broker is not built. Read as a Go bool: 1, t or true turn it on; on and yes do not. Needs CODEX_SUBSCRIPTION_HOME and CODEX_SUBSCRIPTION_MODEL_PLANE_API_KEY.

flags.name: CONNECTOR_SCOPE_RECORD_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS23-S4: a Do run records the ids of the connected accounts selected for the turn on its run record (run_context.connector_scope), ids only; never for a ZDR or waived run. Off, nothing is recorded. Only the literal true; read at start.

flags.name: CONTENT_SAFETY_NORMALIZE
flags.purpose: Normalised injection scan: tighten-only, adds a NOTE and an audit event. Only a falsey word (0, false, no or off) opts out and restores the sixteen-phrase path. session-core's write gate ignores it.
flags.onDefaultReason: On by default. The normalised scan only adds flags, so it can make a screen more cautious and never less. The code default is on too, so this declaration changes nothing at runtime.

flags.name: CONTROL_ALLOW_INSECURE_SESSION_RUN_AUTHORITY_LOOPBACK
flags.purpose: Security-relaxing development opt-in: plaintext to session-core's run authority, only at an IP-loopback address. Off keeps TLS. Other spellings of true are refused. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CONTROL_OWNER_ASSERTED_GRANTS
flags.purpose: WS14-S2: owner-asserted grant writes on user-core's authz grant surface, admitted only for the registered owner service of a resource type. Off, the surface answers 403 and stays fenced. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CONTROL_PLANE_ENFORCEMENT
flags.purpose: Control-plane enforcement mode for the BFF. Unknown values fall back to off. The gateway compose sets strict when the variable is unset; the code reads off when the variable is absent.

flags.name: CONTROL_SPACE_MEMORY_DECISIONS
flags.purpose: EP-8 S7: user-core signs model.space.memory.manage decisions for a shared Space's manager or owner; off answers 404. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CONTROL_SPACE_SHARED_IMPORT
flags.purpose: WS14-S1: shared-Space import decisions for room uploads. Off, a shared import answers 404 shared_import_disabled and the personal-only path stays. A rollout control, never an authorization input. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CONTROL_SPACE_SUBJECT_GRANTS
flags.purpose: WS14-S2: Space-subject grants on user-core. Off, file-grant and GET /authz/space-visible answer 404. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CONVERSATION_ZDR_EFFECTIVE_POSTURE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: ZDR-Z-03d: conversation-core's org-core reader uses the effective posture (retention_posture.effective_zdr) instead of the raw interactiveRetention.zdr flag. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: COST_CORE_IMAGE_PRICING_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Prices image_generation usage per image from image_price_rates. No row is seeded, so an unpriced image is recorded with no image cost and flagged. Off, image events record as ordinary usage. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CRAWL_APPROVAL_MODE
flags.purpose: The knowledge crawl approval gate: off, observe or enforce. Unset or unrecognised means observe. Read once per process, with CRAWL_APPROVAL_PAGES as its threshold.

flags.name: CREDENTIAL_BINDINGS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Credential-binding admin routes in integration-corev2: an org admin binds a secret to one host, sealed here and never returned. Off, the routes answer 404. Needs the credential encryption key. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CREDENTIAL_BINDINGS_UI_ENABLED
flags.purpose: W4-CC-8: the org credential-binding routes and the custom REST connector route. Off, each answers 404 credential_bindings_disabled and nothing is sent to Integration Core. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CRON_SWEEPER_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Background cron sweeper in capability-core. Only the exact value false turns it off.
flags.onDefaultReason: Background sweeper on by default. No compose line sets it, so only the process environment can opt out.

flags.name: CSP_REPORT_LOG_HOSTS
flags.purpose: WS07-S6: logs the blocked origin (scheme and host, never a path or query) of each CSP report, for a host inventory. Dev only: forced off when APP_ENV is production. Only 1, true, yes or on turns it on.

flags.name: CUSTOMER_GATEWAY_CONNECTIONS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Customer-gateway model connections: an org's own OpenAI-compatible endpoint, sealed here. Needs CUSTOMER_GATEWAY_MODEL_PLANE_API_KEY (or the Codex key) and the encryption key. Off, the routes answer 404. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: CUSTOM_REST_CONNECTORS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: A server-side REST proxy for custom_rest connections, using a sealed credential binding's secret. Needs CREDENTIAL_BINDINGS_ENABLED (config refuses otherwise). Off, the provider is unknown. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: DISPOSABLE_EMAIL_BLOCKLIST_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Blocks disposable e-mail domains (auth-core security/disposable-email.ts). On unless the value is the literal false, in any case; 0 and off keep it on.
flags.onDefaultReason: Protective control: the disposable-domain blocklist is on unless an operator sets the literal false.

flags.name: DREAMING_LLM_EXTRACTION
flags.purpose: Dreaming LLM extraction, which sends chat transcripts to a model to propose memories.
flags.driftReason: Code is on when unset (env_flag default true). Compose ships 0 because extraction would send user chats to a paid model on this stack. Owner decision: keep one side or the other.

flags.name: EVENT_TRIGGERS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-7 W4-F T1: the event trigger record store (session-core). Records only; nothing fires until the consumer and FireAuthorizer exist.

flags.name: EVENT_TRIGGERS_UI_ENABLED
flags.purpose: W4-T7: the event trigger routes (/api/v1/event-triggers and its dry run). Off, the paths are absent and answer the fallback 404. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EVENT_TRIGGER_FIRE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-7 W4-F T2: the event trigger fire path in capability-core (the webhook_received consumer and the fire sweeper). Records and authorises fires only; no run starts until the wake gate lands.

flags.name: EVENT_TRIGGER_RUN_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-7 T4 trigger starter: an authorised fire of a trigger naming a cron schedule becomes one scheduled run, re-authorised by Control and bounded by run, hourly and org limits. Needs EVENT_TRIGGER_FIRE_ENABLED. Only the literal true.

flags.name: EVENT_TRIGGER_WAKE_GATE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-7 W4-F T5: the wake gate in capability-core. A fire of a trigger with a wake filter reads its webhook payload from integration-corev2 and needs a match. Off, stored filters are ignored. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EXECUTE_STEP_SPACE_SEARCH_WITHHOLD
flags.purpose: D2-771: ExecuteStep withholds a Space-scoped knowledge_search (typed PROJECT_KNOWLEDGE_UNAVAILABLE, before any Data Plane call) unless x-space-retrieval-authorization is forwarded. Off, org-wide. Only the literal true.

flags.name: EXECUTION_COORDINATOR_MODE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Coordinator Do runs get only read and subagent delegation tools, so effects go through subagents. Never for ZDR, waived or continued runs; the gateway forwards the flag only while on. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CORE_BROWSER_FILL_OTP
flags.purpose: QF-16 (E3.1): a leased non-ZDR browser run with one google or microsoft mail connection may propose fill_otp; each use needs a Login approval and a single-use broker fill_otp grant. Literal true only.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CORE_LEASE_RELEASE_FILTER
flags.purpose: W4-P6: lease release never uploads an unfiltered Space workspace: a ZDR or waived run's workspace is discarded before any upload, other runs upload only write-through-eligible files. Off, unchanged. Only the literal true; read at start.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CORE_PLANNER_RUN_ENV
flags.purpose: E4.3: the planner's view of a leased browser run names the browser environment (tier and Quarry's capability booleans), as advisory text. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CORE_PROVIDER_CONTENT_READS
flags.purpose: Q4-E4.3 (056a/c): the agent's provider content reads (github contents.get, readme.get, notion page.content), their decode and larger caps. Off: not offered, gated as unknown, 2000/8000 caps. Only the literal true.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CORE_QUARRY_ATTRIBUTION
flags.purpose: Q4 E4.6 (062a): execution-core's web search, fetch and crawl tools send x-request-id and x-verevon-parent-run to Quarry so its traces join the run. Neither is sent for a ZDR or waived step. Only the literal true.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CORE_RECIPE_RUNNER
flags.purpose: Q4-E4.2-3h: a browser run whose input names a saved recipe replays that procedure step by step with Quarry, under its own broker grant. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CORE_SKILL_PINS
flags.purpose: EP-11 S3: a Do run records the skill versions it injected, and reattach_skill reads the pinned version. Never for ZDR or waived runs. Off reads the current skill row. Only the literal true; read at start, restart to change.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CORE_SKILL_URL_MATCH
flags.purpose: Q4-E4.3-043c2: a browser run appends the site-skill blocks whose url_patterns match the page after screening. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EXECUTION_CUSTOM_REST_TOOLS
flags.purpose: W4-CC-7 custom REST tools on a turn with a selected connection: Do offers read and write, Ask offers read; writes pause for approval; capabilities start unavailable until attested; ZDR and waived refused. Only the literal true.

flags.name: EXECUTION_DEFERRED_TOOL_INDEX_ENABLED
flags.purpose: W5-070: the Do loop's deferred tool index. Off, a run gets its whole catalogue. On, a catalogue over EXECUTION_DEFERRED_TOOL_INDEX_THRESHOLD offers its MCP and client tools once tool_search reveals them. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: EXECUTION_DO_COMPUTER_ENABLED
flags.purpose: W4-C C1: the Do loop's computer tools (execution-core). Only the literal true turns them on, and even on, every call is refused computer_unavailable until a backend is built.

flags.name: EXECUTION_POST_MUTATION_VERIFY_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Reads each write back in the loop and records the result. Read on every write, so a change needs a restart.

flags.name: EXECUTION_PROCESS_OUTPUT_SPILL
flags.purpose: W4-P6 process_read spill: writes a background process's output beyond one page into a workspace file under .tmp, never uploaded. Only the literal true turns it on. Refused on zero-retention or waived runs. Read once at start.

flags.name: EXECUTION_PROCESS_TTY_ENABLED
flags.purpose: S4.2 process_start tty: a background process on a pseudo-terminal (120x40, TERM=dumb), one output stream. Off gives plain pipes; ZDR and waived tty requests are always refused. Only the literal true; read at start.

flags.name: EXECUTION_SHADOW_REVIEWER
flags.purpose: W5-097-a shadow reviewer: one tool-free inference judges an effectful Do call; the verdict is only counted and logged, never read by permissions, hooks or approvals. ZDR and waived runs skipped. Only the literal true.

flags.name: FEEDBACK_SKILL_VERSIONS
flags.purpose: EP-11 S3 part b: keys feedback ratings by skill version and quarantines a skill only when its newest rated version is below the bar. Only the literal true turns it on; off pools every rating per skill id as before.

flags.name: FINETUNE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Fine-tuning routes master switch. Only the exact value 1 enables it.

flags.name: GATEWAY_AGENT_API_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-12 S8: the public Agent API ingress (/api/agent/v1/*), which exchanges x-api-key at auth-core with the verevon-gateway principal. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: GATEWAY_RATE_CLASSES
flags.purpose: The per-class rate limit layers of the gateway. off, 0, false or no removes them and leaves the default limiter. Unset or any other value keeps them on.
flags.onDefaultReason: Per-class rate limits are on by default. Only off, 0, false or no removes the class layers.

flags.name: GATEWAY_RESULT_CACHE_CONTENT
flags.purpose: Whether the gateway result cache may use its two content caches, search results and scrape previews. Read once at connect. off, 0 or false disables them; the identity and posture caches are not affected.
flags.onDefaultReason: The two content caches are on by default, as they were before this switch was declared.

flags.name: GATEWAY_SPACE_APPEND_RETRIEVAL
flags.purpose: WS18-S2: a follow-up turn of a scoped thread fetches its own retrieval decision and carries its token. Only the literal true turns it on; it never defaults on, even in development.

flags.name: GATEWAY_SPACE_MEMORY_UI
flags.purpose: EP-8 S7: the Space memory routes, which list and delete a room memory. Off, they answer 404 feature_unavailable. Only the literal true turns it on; it never defaults on, even in development.

flags.name: GATEWAY_ZDR_EFFECTIVE_POSTURE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: ZDR-Z-03c: the BFF's one org-posture reader answers from org-core's effective_zdr instead of parsing the stored intent. Off keeps the intent-only rule. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: GATEWAY_ZDR_LOG_FILTER
flags.purpose: The sensitive-field filter of the gateway JSON log. Only off, 0 or false (any case) disables it; any other value keeps it on.
flags.onDefaultReason: The sensitive-field log filter is part of Zero Data Retention, so it stays on unless an operator sets off, 0 or false.

flags.name: GRAFANA_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Anonymous Viewer access to the Control Plane Grafana, set as GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED on controlplane-grafana. Off keeps Grafana behind its login. The Grafana image reads it, not repo code.

flags.name: INFERENCE_BYO_GATEWAY_ENABLED
flags.purpose: F-t3-065 phase 2: a call naming a customer-gateway connection is served by that gateway alone through Integration Core, never a platform provider; never ZDR, billed to the customer. Off refuses it. Only the literal true.

flags.name: INFERENCE_CATALOGUE_OVERLAY
flags.purpose: F-t3-065 phase 1: the platform catalogue overlay (hide, order, model-id aliases) for the listing and pinned requests; it does not change how a model is served. Off ignores a stored overlay. Only the literal true.

flags.name: INFERENCE_GEMINI_EFFORT_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-13: sends thinkingConfig on Gemini requests and lists effort levels for Gemini models. Only the literal true turns it on; off, a Gemini request is unchanged.

flags.name: INFERENCE_LOGPROBS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Master switch for the logprobs request parameter on every provider. 0, false, no or off turns it off.
flags.onDefaultReason: On by default. No compose line sets it, so only the process environment can opt out.

flags.name: INFERENCE_OPENAI_PROMPT_CACHE_KEY
flags.purpose: WS02-S10: sends the provider prompt-cache routing key to the first-party OpenAI endpoint only, never on a ZDR request. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: INFERENCE_ORG_OVERLAY
flags.purpose: W4-BYO-3 per-org overlay (hide, order, role candidates; narrow-only) read from session-core and applied after the platform overlay; entitlement and ZDR, privacy and residency floors still apply. Needs SESSION_ORG_ROUTING_OVERLAY.

flags.name: INFERENCE_PROVIDER_BENCHING
flags.purpose: Benches a failing platform provider and model for a bounded time, never routes a platform request to a user subscription route, and refuses typed when all are benched. Only the literal true.

flags.name: INFERENCE_SAME_TIER_FALLBACK
flags.purpose: Keeps every fallback hop of a call at or above the privacy tier of the first eligible provider. Only the literal true.

flags.name: INFERENCE_SPEED_TIER_SPLIT
flags.purpose: Speed tier is its own choice, not Quick's. On, a request takes priority with speed_tier only where the model record declares it. Off, Quick selects priority as before. Only the literal true enables it.

flags.name: INTEGRATION_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Rate limiter on the integration-corev2 API, sized by INTEGRATION_RATE_LIMIT_MAX per INTEGRATION_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW. Only a Go false value (0, f, false) turns it off; off, no and disabled leave it on.
flags.onDefaultReason: A protective control: the API rate-limits every deployment unless a Go false value turns it off.

flags.name: INTEGRATION_ZDR_EFFECTIVE_POSTURE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: D-ZDR-10: integration-corev2 reads the organisation's effective ZDR posture (retention_posture.effective_zdr) from org-core instead of the stored intent. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: LEARNING_REVIEW_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Kill switch for the learning review, which sends session transcripts to LEARNING_REVIEW_MODEL.
flags.driftReason: Code is on when unset (parseLearningReviewSwitch). Compose ships false so a stack can keep every model call on one route. Owner decision: keep one side or the other.

flags.name: LEARNING_RUN_EVENTS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Writes the run-completed outbox row that feeds the learning loop. false, 0, off or no skips the insert, so no review runs.
flags.onDefaultReason: On by default so the learning loop is live. No compose line sets it, so only the process environment can opt out.

flags.name: LETTA_TOOL_SEARCH_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Turns on Letta tool search. Parsed strictly: any value other than true or false is a configuration error.

flags.name: LETTA_TOOL_SEARCH_MODE
flags.purpose: Letta tool-search retrieval mode. The client rejects any other value.

flags.name: MCP_APPS_NETWORK_ENABLED

flags.name: MEMORY_GATE_CAPABILITY_WRITES

flags.name: MEMORY_GATE_ORCHESTRATOR_WRITES

flags.name: MEMORY_GROUNDING_ENABLED

flags.name: MODEL_ENTITLEMENT_ADMIN_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS10-S5: the model entitlement admin routes (policy read, write and explain). Do not enable before the matcher and model-gateway admission are deployed. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_BROWSER_PAGE_CONTEXT_ENABLED
flags.purpose: QF-10: chat turns read BFF-verified browser_tab_refs and browser_regions as untrusted browser-scraped context and region image parts. Literal true only; ZDR or waived turns are refused.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_BROWSER_RECIPE

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_BYO_GATEWAY

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_CACHE_STABLE_PROMPT_ORDER

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_CAP_MIN

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_COMPACTION_TOKEN_BUDGET

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_DATA_SOURCE_CATALOGUE
flags.purpose: F-t3-093 (b) data-source catalogue: the chat prompt names the sources this turn's tools reach, with use-when and cost hints; a ZDR turn lists only ZDR-allowed ones. Off, the prompt is unchanged. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_DEDUP_CONTEXT_HISTORY

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_EVENT_TRIGGERS
flags.purpose: EP-7 W4-T7: the event trigger routes on model-gateway (/v1/event-triggers and the dry run). Off, every route answers 404. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_GOAL_JUDGE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: EP-7 S3 completion judge: judges a settled, completed goal turn and records its verdict. Needs MODEL_GATEWAY_THREAD_GOALS_ENABLED. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_GOAL_UNATTENDED_ENABLED

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_GRAPH_SPACE_SCOPE

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_MCP_PROBE

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_MODEL_COUNCIL_ENABLED
flags.purpose: F-t3-092 model council: two to four models answer one question with no tools, then a synthesis of agreement and disagreement. Cost is estimated first. Nothing stored. Off, the route is a 404. Only the literal true.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_NAMED_AGENT_THREADS

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_QUARRY_ATTRIBUTION

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_REASONING_TRANSLATE_ENABLED
flags.purpose: F-t3-098 reasoning translation of one shown text to nb or en (POST /v1/ai/reasoning-translate), never stored or fed back to the model; ZDR and waived turns refused. Off, the route is a 404. Only the literal true.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_RESEARCH_RUNS

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_REVIEW_RUN_ENABLED
flags.purpose: F-t3-086 review as a run: a read-only reviewer over one text, answered on the inline path and stored nowhere. Off, the route is a 404. Only the literal true, in any case, turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_ROUTING_DECISION_ENABLED
flags.purpose: W5-073-b: the answer's verevon mode, complexity and reason on usage frames, the usage envelope, message metadata and the Routed line. Closed tokens only; needs INFERENCE_ROUTE_NOTE. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_SIDE_CHAT_ENABLED
flags.purpose: F-t3-069 side chat: a read-only question about one thread's transcript, answered and never stored (POST /v1/threads/:id/side-chat). Off, the route is a 404. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_SPEED_TIER

flags.purpose: F-t3-081 teach mode: one run's steps are drafted into a disabled skill proposal for the owner (POST /v1/teach/skill-draft). Off, the route is a 404. Only the literal true, in any case, turns it on.

flags.name: NATS_ALLOW_TOKEN_FALLBACK

flags.name: ORCHESTRATOR_GOAL_JUDGE_ACTIVITY_ENABLED

flags.name: ORG_CORE_KEYS_ENABLED

flags.name: ORG_DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_ENABLED

flags.name: ORG_RETENTION_POLICY_ENABLED

flags.name: ORG_ROLE_CAPABILITIES_ENABLED

flags.name: ORG_SIEM_DESTINATIONS_ENABLED

flags.name: PERSONAL_SETUP_VISIBLE

flags.name: PLUGIN_LOADER_ENABLED

flags.name: POLICY_EFFECTIVE_VIEW_ENABLED
flags.purpose: The effective policy view (/api/v1/policy/effective), which shows each owner value and where it came from. Off, the route is not mounted. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: PROCESS_SWEEPER_ENABLED

flags.name: QUARRY_EDGE__ZDR_EFFECTIVE_POSTURE_ENABLED

flags.name: RESEARCH_RUNS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Q4 E4.6 (062b): the durable research run record store (session-core ResearchRunService). Records only; nothing starts a research run until the gateway slice (MODEL_GATEWAY_RESEARCH_RUNS) lands.

flags.name: SCHEDULE_CONTRACT_ENABLED
flags.purpose: WS20-S4: stored-consent schedule contracts. Off, a create request that carries a contract is refused. Blocked by depth-register D0-010: keep it off until step-time re-verification of the contract is built. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: SCIM_EDGE_ENABLED

flags.name: SESSION_THREAD_IMPORT_FOREIGN_ENABLED

flags.name: SESSION_THREAD_RECEIPT_ENFORCE
flags.purpose: Z-17: CreateThread stamps the retention receipt; AppendMessage refuses a caller whose posture differs (zdr_posture_mismatch) before any write; a waiver needs the same connection and acknowledgement. No receipt = persistent. Only true.

flags.name: SKILL_BUNDLE_MOUNT_ENABLED

flags.name: VITE_SHELL_TOASTS
flags.purpose: F-t3-078 shell toasts: short notices that outlive the panel that raised them. Presentation only. Off, showing a toast does nothing. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: VITE_ZDR_WAIVER_UI
flags.purpose: ZDR-Z-19d: the SPA's connection ZDR acknowledgement UI and its client. Off, nothing is read from the gateway and nothing is shown. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: WATCH_SWEEPER_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Background watch sweeper in capability-core. Only the exact value false turns it off.
flags.onDefaultReason: Background sweeper on by default. No compose line sets it, so only the process environment can opt out.

flags.name: WEB_POLICY_CLAIM_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Web-policy claim on tokens for the audiences that carry it (auth-core web-policy.ts). Off, such a token carries rev 0 and org-core is never asked. Only 1 or true turns it on.

flags.name: WIDE_RESEARCH_CHILD_BUDGET_ENFORCED
flags.purpose: Wave 3 EP-2 S9: enforces the child token budget of one wide-research fan-out call (WIDE_RESEARCH_CHILD_TOKEN_BUDGET). Only the literal true enforces it; off, a spent budget is logged and every item still starts.

flags.name: WIDE_RESEARCH_FAN_OUT_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Kill switch for the wide-research fan-out tool. 0, false, off, no or disabled stops offering and dispatching it.
flags.onDefaultReason: A kill switch, on by design, for the subscription route's rate limits.

flags.name: ZDR_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_ENABLED
flags.purpose: ZDR-Z-13: the connection ZDR acknowledgement routes and the retention sweep in integration-corev2. Off, the routes do not exist and the sweep does not run, so revoked rows are kept until it is on. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: ZDR_TYPED_REFUSALS_ENABLED
flags.purpose: Z-05a: on a ZDR or waived turn, web search and file or artifact writes are typed zdr_feature_not_supported refusals. V3-mg-1-rel3: a ZDR refusal off the subscription route ends the turn typed, no unary fallback. Only the literal true.

flags.name: ZDR_WAIVER_ENABLED
flags.purpose: ZDR-Z-14: the per-connection ZDR waiver issuer. Off refuses every waiver with zdr_connection_not_supported. Only the literal true turns it on.

flags.name: ZDR_WAIVER_UI_ENABLED
flags.purpose: ZDR-Z-19a: the BFF asks Auth Core for a retention decision on a subscription chat turn and mounts the connection ZDR routes. Off, no decision is asked and no route is mounted. Only the literal true turns it on.
